bok.text: The Hyozan Reckoners grow when Toshi goes to the Heart of Frost, gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and captures her in a magic disk, which forces Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into the allegiance.
Later Night's Reach calls in Toshi's debt and has him leave the Hyozan Reckoners, though his intentions secretly diverge from hers.
